title: AARO Satellite Flaring Paper
doc_notes: This document is an AARO information paper explaining how satellite flaring and satellite trains from mega-constellations like Starlink can be misinterpreted as UAP, including methodology for observers to identify these phenomena.

incidents.summary: AARO personnel photographed Starlink satellite flares near Sidney, Nebraska.
incidents.quote: Photo taken before sunrise on March 11, 2024 near Sidney, Nebraska.
